name: AaveBoost proxyDeposit pays the fixed reward on zero-amount deposits
summary: AaveBoost.proxyDeposit adds a fixed 0.3 AAVE REWARD from its own balance to every deposit it forwards to the pool, with no minimum amount, and once the balance falls below REWARD it deposits the caller's amount from its own balance without pulling it. The attacker called it 163 times with amount 0 and itself as recipient, minted 48.9 brAAVE and withdrew the AAVE from the pool; a MEV bot later took the 0.0486 AAVE remainder through the fallback branch.
notes: The 21 earlier proxyDeposit calls (2022) each pulled 0.1 to 800 AAVE from their sender and received one reward: intended use, not exploits. setPool was never called, so the pool and REWARD date from deployment.
